videoTitle: You're Applying Antiperspirant at the Wrong Time (And That's Why It Fails)
videoDescription: Stress sweating before a big event isn't just nerves—it's your nervous system activating sweat glands that don't respond to the usual fixes. The timing of when you apply antiperspirant changes everything. Find out what actually works at mindtivate.com
script: You've been applying antiperspirant in the morning. That's exactly when it doesn't work. For stress sweating, you need to apply it at night to dry skin, because your sweat glands are less active while you sleep, which means...
Visit mindtivate.com to find the answer.
thumbnailConcept: A close-up, high-contrast shot of a frustrated man looking down in dismay at a prominent, damp sweat patch on the underarm of his light blue dress shirt. His face captures a mix of annoyance and embarrassment as he lifts his arm slightly, realizing his morning deodorant has completely failed him before his day has even begun.
